name: Abiko Yumi
source:
A sporty second-year girl.

She is the upcoming ace of the track club and holds the junior high record for short distance running. Her presence brightens the atmosphere, and she' not afraid to share her smile with anyone.
She is a beautiful girl who is popular with men and women alike.
